parsed.rationale: Both members are exact duplicates of the computed property `CGImage.pngDataCompatibility` defined twice within the same file `Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkServiceTests.swift` in the `Artwork` package (at lines 73 and 103). Neither record carries any restraint marker (is_test, is_mock, is_sample_app, is_codegen are all false), so the duplication is unambiguously redundant rather than intentional. The fix is straightforward: remove one of the two declarations so that a single definition of `pngDataCompatibility` exists in that file. Because both occurrences live in the same file, no cross-file extraction is needed — this is purely an intra-file deduplication.
